2607.02369.title: World Wide Models: Literary Tools for Cultural AI
2607.02369.paper_summary: LLMs stage a new form of cultural encounter that is massive, automated, and monolingual. Literary disciplines have always negotiated cultural struggles with comparative reading of literature, narratological and poetic analysis, critical theory, world literature, and translation. These tools have now become indispensable for building culturally literate AI. The essay develops a layered framework toward more nuanced textual models and pluralistic interpretations of AI, emphasizing the natural intersections of literature and AI development, connecting current debates in critical theory with structural monolingualism, and suggesting a new application of world literature approaches to address global AI textuality through macrostructure, circulation, and untranslatability.
2607.02369.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 上演了一種新的文化遭遇形式，這種形式是龐大、自動化且單語的。文學學科一直以來都在通過比較文學的閱讀、敘事學和詩學分析、批評理論、世界文學和翻譯來協商文化鬥爭。這些工具現在已成為構建具文化素養的 AI 的不可或缺的部分。這篇文章發展出一個分層框架，以便對 AI 進行更細緻的文本模型和多元解釋，強調文學與 AI 發展的自然交集，將當前的批評理論辯論與結構性單語主義聯繫起來，並建議將世界文學的方法應用於通過宏觀結構、流通和不可翻譯性來解決全球 AI 文本性問題。
2607.02369.author: Nina Begus et.al.
